image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of three green cucumbers arranged on a plain white background. One cucumber is in the immediate foreground, showing its rounded end and textured skin with water droplets. Two other cucumbers are positioned behind it, one partially visible in the upper left and another in the upper right. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the waxy texture and small bumps on the rind.

Standard depth-of-field blur is present, but the transition between sharp and blurred areas is exceptionally smooth, potentially indicating AI-generated bokeh rather than optical lens blur.
